title: Your interview
question: What did the consulate ask you to clarify?
hint: Use the exact notice where possible. Do not include passport, visa case, Social Security or full account numbers.
fields: Notice date, cited section and requested evidence

title: Household
question: Who will move with you, and who depends on your support?
hint: Include each household member, relationship, age and whether accompanying. Add a separate adult record later for every adult.
fields: Household members, ages, relationships and dependents remaining abroad
Childcare, schooling and other dependent-care plans

title: Residence & housing
question: Where will you live when you arrive, and what supports that plan?
hint: Distinguish a signed lease, a host's commitment and a location you are still considering.
fields: Address or area, household capacity, duration and fallback
Monthly housing cost (USD; use 0 only if confirmed free)

title: Liquid funds
question: Which funds can your household actually access for settlement?
hint: Add each account once. Use an alias, never an account number. Report your accessible share after joint ownership or restrictions; borrowed funds must also be disclosed as liabilities.
fields: Transfer restrictions, recent deposits, borrowed funds or access delays

title: Assets & liabilities
question: What other assets or obligations affect your settlement plan?
hint: Do not count property, retirement funds or possible sales as liquid cash. Include debts, repayment schedules and ongoing support obligations.
fields: Other assets: owner, currency, value, valuation date and evidence
Liabilities: creditor alias, currency, amount, payment schedule and evidence
Realization timing, sale costs and restrictions

title: Work & qualifications
question: How will this adult support the household after arrival?
hint: Record each adult separately, including non-working adults. A job search is not an offer. A foreign degree does not itself establish a U.S. license.
fields: Current work, income/currency and whether it continues after relocation
U.S. employer/role, search activity or offer terms and start date
U.S. licensing requirements, status, costs and timeline
Funding and alternative plan until work begins

title: Family & sponsor support
question: Who, if anyone, has committed to supporting your household?
hint: Record promises separately from funds already available. Do not assume that a formal affidavit is required or sufficient; follow the consulate's category-specific instructions.
fields: Supporter, relationship, type/amount/currency, duration and conditions
Evidence of capacity and any requested affidavit / applicability review

title: Health & insurance
question: How will every family member's health costs be covered?
hint: A request for a quote is not a quote; a quote is not active coverage. You may describe care costs without listing diagnoses.
fields: Carrier / plan, covered members, geographic network and coverage type
Deductible, out-of-pocket maximum, exclusions and subsidy assumptions
Quote date/expiry, proposed effective date and enrollment conditions
Anticipated care costs, coverage gap and how those costs will be funded

title: Settlement budget
question: What will arrival and a typical month cost?
hint: Enter USD estimates and their basis. Blank means unknown, not zero. Insurance and housing are entered here too; check consistency with the preceding sections. Income is excluded from the conservative runway calculation.
fields: Monthly debt and other support obligations
One-time travel, deposits, furnishings and fees
Estimate dates, sources, exclusions and contingencies

title: Benefits history
question: Is there any U.S. public-benefits history relevant to the consulate's questions?
hint: Answer accurately; do not stop or avoid needed benefits based on this tool. Treatment can depend on the program, recipient and circumstances. Seek qualified advice for interpretation.
fields: Recipient, program, agency, dates, amount, circumstances and records; or questions for counsel

title: Evidence index
question: Which documents support the facts you have entered?
hint: Keep originals outside the app. This is an index, not an upload or authenticity check. References can be a filename, exhibit or page range. Never describe a missing document as available.
fields: Facts supported and page / file reference
